dependencyDashboardHeader: Non-GitHub pins (Claude Code CLI, cursor-agent, AWS CLI v2) are tracked through custom datasources; the Debian base image is digest-pinned and the FuelLabs reusable workflow is tracked by branch digest. Sources and manual check commands: `docs/dependency-updates.md`.

packageRules.description: Every pin tracked here is part of the image this repo publishes, so a bump is a release-triggering `fix`, not a silent `chore`. A top-level `semanticCommitType` cannot express that: `config:recommended` extends `:semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers`, whose `matchPackageNames: ["*"]` rule sets `chore` for dependencies with no package-manager depType, and package rules are applied after top-level config. This rule is appended after the preset's, so it wins for every manager (regex custom managers, `github-actions`, `dockerfile`, `git-refs`).

claude-code-releases.description: Claude Code CLI: downloads.claude.ai serves the newest published version as a plain-text body at /latest.

cursor-agent-lab.description: cursor-agent CLI: downloads.cursor.com exposes no listing or feed, but Cursor's own installer script hardcodes the current lab build path, so the version is extracted from that script body.

aws-cli-changelog.description: AWS CLI v2: aws/aws-cli's own CHANGELOG.rst lists every released version as its own line, so the changelog doubles as the version list.

customManagers.description: Multica CLI pin (ARG MULTICA_VERSION in Dockerfile) -> multica-ai/multica GitHub releases. Tag is `vX.Y.Z`, the ARG holds `X.Y.Z` (no `v`), so extractVersionTemplate strips the prefix.

asdf pin (ARG ASDF_VERSION in Dockerfile) -> asdf-vm/asdf GitHub releases. Upstream tags are `vX.Y.Z` and the ARG keeps the `v` (the download URL is built from the raw value), so no extractVersionTemplate is used: the release version is the tag text and is written back verbatim. semver-coerced only orders the `v`-prefixed tags; it does not rewrite them.
GitHub CLI pin (ARG GH_VERSION in Dockerfile) -> cli/cli GitHub releases. Tag is `vX.Y.Z`, the ARG holds `X.Y.Z` (the download URL adds the `v` itself), so extractVersionTemplate strips the prefix.

aws-sso-cli pin (ARG AWS_SSO_VERSION in Dockerfile) -> synfinatic/aws-sso-cli GitHub releases. Tag is `vX.Y.Z`, the ARG holds `X.Y.Z` (the download URL adds the `v` itself), so extractVersionTemplate strips the prefix.

Claude Code CLI pin (ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION in Dockerfile) -> downloads.claude.ai latest-version endpoint. That body is one line, and the plain fetcher turns lines into releases, so one release comes back.
cursor-agent CLI pin (ARG CURSOR_AGENT_VERSION in Dockerfile) -> version pulled out of Cursor's installer script. CalVer `YYYY.MM.DD-<gitsha>`; loose versioning orders it.
AWS CLI v2 pin (ARG AWS_CLI_VERSION in Dockerfile) -> every version heading in aws/aws-cli CHANGELOG.rst. semver versioning discards the non-version lines.

FuelLabs/github-actions reusable workflow, SHA-pinned in docker-publish.yml. Upstream publishes no tags and no releases, so the built-in github-actions manager marks the ref `unversioned-reference` (enabled: false) and it never reaches the dashboard. Track the master branch tip instead: git-refs datasource + currentDigest, so a moved branch yields a digest bump that rewrites only the SHA.
